text:
maria: Quick kickoff — sprint 3 email cascade for the benchmark launch + webinar hook. primary goal: drive webinar signups and demo requests across cold/warm cohorts. timeline: send next Tue-Fri window. :rocket:
aj: ok — suggest 4-message flow: 1) launch announce, 2) webinar invite, 3) case study + reminder, 4) last-chance + nudge. keep senders as 'Redwood Team' or 'Product'.
sam: creative note — use 1200x628 hero for launch msg, smaller banner for reminder. i can drop sizes by EOD.
jen: working subject line variants — quick ideas: 
```
[New] Fast inference for prod teams — Redwood Optimize launch
Save on token costs without sacrificing quality — webinar inside
See our new benchmark + live demo (RSVP)
Last chance: benchmark walk-through + Q&A
```
kevin: deliverability checklist: suppression against recent webinar attendees, 7-day soft bounces, DKIM/SPF already good. need final ESP list — are we sending from SendGrid or SFMC?
aj: SendGrid for this batch. kevin can you confirm IP warmup status?
kevin: ops-bot: warming status?
ops-bot: IP pool "redwood-prod-3" has 72% warm, projected steady state by Apr 2.
kevin: cool. recommend sending cohorts by recency: Warm (30d eng/product+trial users) -> Lukewarm (90d) -> Cold (all others in target list). stagger windows: 9am/11am/2pm PT to avoid spikes.
maria: segmentation rules: 
- Warm: recent signups with >3 API calls and no Dedicated interest tag
- Lukewarm: trial w/out activity in last 14d
- Cold: content subscribers who opened 0-1 in last 30d
Also exclude 'opt-out' and 'enterprise-do-not-contact'.
jen: can we personalize first line by product interest? e.g., "Saw you tried the API — here's how others cut token costs". A/B test with generic lead gen version.
aj: yes do 50/50. track with utm_campaign=sprint3_cascade and utm_content=variantA/B.
sam: creative question — do we include CTA to register or straight to benchmark landing page? i prefer register first, then follow-up to benchmark download. keeps attendance higher.
maria: agree. CTA order: register -> reminder email includes benchmark link -> post-webinar follow-up with download + product demo CTA.
kevin: scheduling + throttles: throttle at 1000/min, retry for 5xx with exponential backoff. also add prefix suppression to avoid dupes if a person is in multiple cohorts same day.
jen: I uploaded copy drafts to the campaign doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/sprint3/email-copy (please review). need content approvals by Thu 3pm PT to hit Tue send.
aj: i'll run audience QA Wed morning. sam — will you supply final images by Wed noon?
sam: yep will push final assets into /marketing/assets/sprint3 by 11:30am Wed.
maria: tagging checklist: "email:launch_sprint3", "webinar:benchmark_apr". use these tags in the event payload for analytics.
kevin: remind: set automation for webinar registrants -> calendar invite + 24h reminder. also include fallback when demo slots fill: point to self-serve sandbox.
jen: subject + preheader test matrix: test 3 subjects x 2 preheaders x 2 send days = 12 combos. limit to top segments (Warm + Lukewarm) for the matrix.
aj: agree. final QA: test sends to internal list (maria, aj, jen, kevin, sam) + 5 external test emails. check links, images, and unsub.
maria: approvals: product (aj), legal (cc legal@redwood.ai), deliverability (kevin). once approved I schedule in SendGrid for Tue 9am PT warm segment.
jen: small copy tweak — change "token costs" to "per-token cost" in variant B.
aj: noted. any blockers?
sam: none.
kevin: nothing from ops.
maria: sweet — we'll reconvene Thu after sign-off. thanks everyone :pray:
